test_title: RRB NTPC - UG 2025 (CBT 1): Morning Practice - Day 1
subject: general
question:
Given below is a pair of words / letters / numbers separated by a colon and followed by four answer choices. Choose the pair of words in the answer choices that best expresses a relationship similar to that expressed in the original pair.

ABC : ZYX : :
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

The logic followed here is:​

ABC : ZYX

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/68bfaa117dcb27e85062a2f7e50f201c17d97a1fb78b075531216e5754400739.png] 

Option 1) BCD : YXW 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/905d69fb1e2c559b19adbd0c1a04efdd1d3f71a8327fc062dc9bf85c5bb5685c.png] 

Option 2) CDE : XVZ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5f02c6420223ba0ce09fb0329853e330d28acd19375475ee33b72554ac3787d7.png] 

Option 3) BDE : XCD

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9c41769a5768849cbb9b11ff0bf05f2807f36b85635e39e812c2ba5cd0447fae.png] 

Option 4) CBC : XZY

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/978dc7e4d98946508eae1920834d0fca7b5c8a880ff471272a7933fce479b10a.png] 

Thus, out of all the options 'BCD : YXW' best expresses a relationship similar to that expressed in the original pair.

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer.
